scope: Advisor decision-brief interface and bounded deterministic reasoning; no new upstream source or claim assessment

implementation.landing: Coverage-first invitation; no insufficient assessment before explicit build
implementation.brief: Established evidence, relevant unverified context, version comparisons, missing user facts, missing evidence, current conflicts, historical corrections and concrete next verification
implementation.privacy: Goal/theme-only links; optional local profiles; one-use ten-minute private Release Guide context note without changing comparison selections or choosing a target
implementation.legacy: Earlier broad ITSI, ingest-pressure and keep-current URLs retain an explicit scope/not-covered explanation without manufacturing an assessment
